contexts.text: The mansions in the ark = the two parts of man, which are the will and the understanding. AC 644.
The heavenly societies are called by the Lord mansions.
I was led through some of the mansions of the first Heaven...
Souls recently from the world are taken by the Angels round many mansions, which are separate Societies...
I also have been led through mansions... AC 1523. AC 2757. AC 6210. SE 299.
They turned in to him = abode.
Where there is an abode of the intelligent and wise, chariots and horses continually appear.
Hence there are so many Heavens, which in the Word are called mansions.
There are many who have abodes under the soles of the feet...
We will make our abode with him = to dwell in his good. AC 10153:end.
To have an abode with those of the Spiritual Church. Signified.
The abode of the Lord with man is in the good that is in him.
King's houses = the abodes where the Angels are, and in the universal sense, Heaven.
Windows according to the number of mansions or chambers...
On the habitations and mansions of the Angels. General article.
Hence it is that the angelic abodes are indeed in Heaven and to the sight are separate from the abodes where men are, but still they are with man in his affections of good and truth. Illustrated.
(Comparison made with a column divided into three degrees or stories.)
These two faculties are the Lord's abode in the human race... But the Lord's abode is closer with a man in proportion as the man opens the higher degrees by means of these faculties.
An abode is given them.
Stairs from story to story.
The human mind is like the three stories of a house. TCR 24:2. TCR 186. TCR 395:2. Explained.
The Lord then makes His abode with him.
The rooms of that house that are underground.
That they who are elevated from the Lower Earth into... Heaven have mansions most exactly allotted to them. General article.
The celestials who are in some mansion are at once able to feel and perceive whether it agrees with their character... and also in what place of the mansion... they can have consociation.

That they who are led to their mansions seem to be carried about... They suppose themselves to be borne in a chariot, and so to be carried about as it were through labyrinthine ways, backwards and forwards, in order that they may come to the mansion where are they who have almost the same character. SE 309. SE 310.
That those who have not come so recently from the bodily life can be admitted into the mansions of a more inward Heaven, yet in another way.
On mansions. (Of doves, etc.)
